name: B47ANCE'd UI

features.text: Public Lua client API 1: styled native controls, renderer, layout, dialogs, focus and bounded tooltips.
Near-black shared surfaces, grey default accent and instance-rounded corners; explicit Small/Normal button helpers preserve existing geometry and native callbacks. Legacy Large calls alias Normal.
Separate large-text MenuButton component for consumer-owned main/pause-style navigation; transparent backing, no button frame, label-only scoped accent hover/controller focus.

Native main/Esc navigation adapter: large text with scoped accent hover/controller underline, preserving native label identities, actions, visibility, controller rows (the separate background adapter lays out the main-menu column). No global class override or tick scan.

Security-room main menu: four independent 1-60 second static startups then persistent no-signal loops; dynamic native/mod-added menu rows fit the chosen menu rectangle while retaining callbacks. Artwork/crop remains uniform through32:9; independent menu/logo defaults and existing overrides use viewport clamps. Offline fixtures only for this revision.
Main-menu-only runtime music gain mute; saved options unchanged and native exit restores configured gain. Audible rain/thunder suppression NOT TESTED.

Continuous security room expanded to the right: desk reframed toward center-left, one wall/pipe/baseboard/floor perspective and lamp, uniform cover scaling through 32:9 with four transparent CRTs and a separate left menu. PZ runtime NOT TESTED.
Bunker/security artwork decoration: right filing cabinets, archive boxes, noticeboard, key rack, intercom/extinguisher; low footlocker/vent at far left with menu area clear.

Dev.11 selected pipe artwork retained unchanged: horizontal conduit across the left wall, cropfocus680 and measured CRT masks. Old center405/wallY116-470 anchors are superseded by the approved saved default layout in dev.3; art/runtime provenance remains historical.

Local main-menu layout editor: independent menu/logo move/resize, aspect lock, native percentage sliders and Save/Cancel/Reset. Normalized schema1 preferences; F10/controller X access, capture/focus cleanup and dynamic mod-entry fitting. Offline tests only; native acceptance NOT TESTED.

Owner-approved saved main-menu/logo placement is the shipped default for new/missing/invalid/reset layouts: normalized menu18/14.5/27.9696133/52.5%, logo4/26.5/22% with native proportions. Valid local overrides keep priority; schema1 and user files unchanged. Offline viewport/ratio/precedence/editor tests pass; native defaults acceptance NOT TESTED.

Native Options/settings presentation: near-black backdrop, rounded tab/button surfaces, active-tab underline and existing local accent. Instance-only palette/drawing retains native fonts/geometry/callbacks/options, page stencil and input ownership; custom renderers and swatches guarded, shared dropdown temporary palette restores. Native acceptance NOT TESTED.

Optional PZOPT_MENU title/status adapter: shared centered menu title, reserved live version/update line beneath, aligned controller glyph and original callback/render/status ownership; no external dependency or code reuse. Native integration NOT TESTED.
In-game hex/RGB accent editor with live scoped preview, per-consumer/local-player persistence, opacity-only migration and reset to grey.
Consumer/player scoped local appearance with legacy import, lazy appearance editor and original clipboard drawing.
Live CCTV camera feeds, full vanilla UI overhaul and automatic adoption of arbitrary window layouts remain planned.

Public Workshop MP test item 3822582242 updated to 0.5.0-dev.11 after PR 14, with 52-file source/ZIP/stage parity, SteamCMD commit-success and exact public description. Steam unchanged by user choice; native/dedicated NOT TESTED.
Actual native Options Interface page opens appearance or safe HUD editing while preserving native tabs/settings/stencil/Apply/Back. Native acceptance NOT TESTED.

Main-menu black-canvas HUD workspace with ten built-in static samples, eight supported native geometry bindings and two reference-only assets. Scoped public provider register/resolve/apply API and separate schema1 local profile preserve unavailable-provider records. Mechanics height-only, fixed native sizes retained, controller player layouts skipped; no frontend world/player construction. Native runtime NOT TESTED.

Shared compact inspectors: larger slider thumbs/steps, numeric percentages, eight-edge/corner grips for freely resizable assets, batched clamping, pending-field target/reset guards and explicit popup/capture/focus cleanup. Offline fixtures PASS; native input NOT TESTED.

Owned confirmation before voluntary unsaved layout exits: Keep editing defaults safely, Discard writes nothing; pending/invalid inputs, Reset and editor switching are guarded. Underlying slider child focus is cleared; popup/capture/focus cleanup is bounded. Offline tests PASS; native input NOT TESTED.

Deferred Options lifecycle correction: instance create/post-prerender observation attaches native styling and one Interface page per tabs generation. Native returns/errors and custom-renderer guards remain; no global class/provider dependency. Failed dev.2 visual acceptance reproduced offline; post-fix native render/input NOT TESTED.

Native Options workspace: persistent searchable header/categories, section selector and measured contained row pages with original native controls. Crowded categories page explicitly; only genuine specialized/provider overflow scrolls. Native option/Apply/parent/controller/visibility ownership retained. Dismissed-popup and separator regressions PASS offline; native post-fix acceptance NOT TESTED.

HUD editor input correction: fixed hit-test canvas supports direct preview moves/allowed grip resizes and inert blank clicks; explicit Save and shared unsaved Cancel/Escape guard. Dropdown pointer-release guards, stale-root protection and modal draft retention; native click routing NOT TESTED.

Main-menu native Quit to desktop confirmation skin: near-black rounded dialog/buttons and local accent, strict native instance/callback/text guards. Existing frontend layout observes class/instance fields; native text/geometry/actions/focus retained, in-game/custom dialogs excluded. Native acceptance NOT TESTED.

Editable local style preset books: shared/per-mod component colors, opacity/corners/borders and slider visuals; CRUD/inherit/reset and optional preset bindings. Stable Options Interface inspector previews live with explicit checked Save, unsaved protection, scoped focus/input veil and guarded native adapters. API1 Styles/Slider/StyleEditor additions; native acceptance NOT TESTED.

Kahlua startup compatibility correction: private pairs-based presence helper replaces all eight unsupported global-next calls; full behavioral suite uses next=nil and active source is guarded. Actual dev.1 frontend failure reproduced offline; post-fix native acceptance pending.

Native Options section-dropdown compatibility fix: verified setToolTipMap/defaultTooltip after clear replaces unsupported setTooltip. Actual dev.3 Kahlua attach failure reproduced at identical source call in strict fixture; current suite passes, native post-fix acceptance pending.

First native overhaul: world/item/empty-container context menus and pooled submenus, live inventory/loot chrome/neutral rows, owned buttons/vertical scrollbar palette, reached tooltip frames and selected Options/inventory dialogs. Native guards preserve actions/geometry/semantic colours; explicit player preset context and exception-safe draws. Native acceptance NOT TESTED.

Dev.2 fixes actual dev.1 startup nil Add: register the missing empty-inventory event through vanilla LuaEventManager only when absent. Strict absent/preexisting/repeated-load/dispatch regression PASS. Native overhaul visual/input acceptance pending.

2026-10-24 current menu audit:61 grouped work areas/623 installed candidates/187 curated source targets/169 evidence-file bindings; complete frontend/gameplay remaining-menu registers and per-instance/route coverage. Source-bound scanner refuses changed runtime/version; counts are not screens/completion, runtime acceptance not inferred.

Broad native Lua chrome rollout: registry of591 class declarations, deferred/late instance adoption across frontend/gameplay/admin/debug/controller families, guarded shared controls and separate PZAPI lifecycle. Preserves main-menu/editor/inventory/Options owners, player presets, native actions/semantics and provider boundaries. Native acceptance NOT TESTED.
53 editable color channels, hex/RGB and19 family choices including Scrollbar and All. Native state palettes preserve input/semantics; unsupported engine/custom content remains explicit.

Enabled data-only preset packs populate an inactive catalogue. Explicit selection previews a detached editable copy; Save persists, Cancel restores. Source removal/update preserves saved copies. Catalogue256/local16 bounds.

One-button authored-preset data export with explicit New/Update identity, checked completion/status and native Options/Workshop handoff. Optional manually started Python helper stages dependent data-only mods with fixed inventory, transactional rollback/history and exact native metadata preservation. Final native Publish stays explicit; actual discovery/export/upload NOT TESTED.

limits: 0.12.0-dev.1 compatible MINOR local-presentation colors/catalogue/export addition; API1 and schemas/defaults compatible. Offline suites PASS:78 runtime files/198 keys/29 unreviewed English-fallback locales. 61-area route/limit record is not a screen-completion claim. Bespoke rows/inner textures, inaccessible local classes, native engine clock/moodles/radials/model/document content and unknown providers retain explicit boundaries. Native rendering/input/controller/split-screen/performance/load order and PZAPI Meta dispatch NOT TESTED. Earlier audits/startup tests remain historical; G6 NOT TESTED, project G7/stable G8 BLOCKED. No deploy/launch/package/upload; Workshop remains0.5.0-dev.11. Native input text/placeholders limited to API-owned inputs; PZAPI universal thumb-hover/cursor/selection unavailable. Exports omit layouts and legacy Appearance preferences. Helper setup is required for new Workshop staging; no pure-Lua one-click upload claim.
